purpose: Practical licensed-chart key comparisons. These product listings support chart-level comparison and do not automatically establish a particular recording's tonic.

sources.title: Tears in Heaven
sources.scopeNote: The listing says A major is the original published key; it does not identify a particular Eric Clapton master.

sources.title: Wonderwall
sources.format: Oasis leadsheet with lyrics, melody, and chords
sources.scopeNote: The page describes a 3-page Oasis leadsheet in F-sharp minor; no exact album performance/master is named.

sources.title: Let It Be
sources.format: Official Beatles guitar chord chart and lyric sheet
sources.scopeNote: Sony/ATV listing, two pages, C major; no particular album take or duration is bound.

sources.title: Yesterday
sources.format: Official Beatles guitar chord chart and lyric sheet
sources.scopeNote: The app output is recording-scoped F while this listing is an arrangement in G; these claims are not like-scoped.

sources.title: Here Comes the Sun
sources.format: Official Beatles guitar chord chart and lyric sheet
sources.scopeNote: The listing identifies a two-page chord chart in D major; it does not bind the chart to an album master or disclose whether the guitar part is transposed.

sources.title: Free Fallin'
sources.format: Tom Petty guitar tab and chord chart
sources.scope: artist arrangement with Full Moon Fever catalog association
sources.scopeNote: The product page associates the arrangement with Full Moon Fever but describes it as this particular arrangement; its D-major label needs capo/notation-scope review before comparing to a sounding recording key.

sources.title: Sweet Home Alabama
sources.format: Lynyrd Skynyrd guitar tab and chord chart
sources.scopeNote: The listing says D major for the guitar chart but does not identify the recording edition or clarify capo/sounding-key treatment.

sources.title: Perfect
sources.format: Ed Sheeran guitar chord chart and lyric sheet
sources.scopeNote: The listing gives G major for this arrangement; it does not identify the recording version or state whether a capo/transposition is involved.

sources.title: Take Me Home, Country Roads
sources.format: John Denver piano/vocal/guitar single with chord names and guitar chord diagrams
sources.scopeNote: The licensed Cherry Lane listing identifies John Denver and A major, but does not name an album performance.

sources.title: Jolene
sources.product: Dr. Tom's Charts via Sheet Music Plus
sources.format: Dolly Parton guitar chart with transposed Am, original C#m, and capo-5 options
sources.scope: artist arrangement with 1973 album Jolene association
sources.scopeNote: The listing explicitly calls C-sharp minor the original key, includes that chart and a capo-5 version that sounds in C-sharp minor; this is a useful but secondary chart source, not exact-master proof.

sources.title: Ring of Fire
sources.format: Johnny Cash guitar chord chart / TAB
sources.scopeNote: Musicnotes lists G major as the original published key for this Johnny Cash guitar chart. It does not identify an exact album master.

sources.title: Hurt
sources.scope: Johnny Cash arrangement associated with American IV
sources.scopeNote: Musicnotes lists A minor as the original published key, and its appearances section associates the product with American IV. The Johnny Cash official track page confirms Hurt is from American IV. The sheet arrangement is not claimed to reproduce the exact master; current app key is unavailable.

sources.title: Shallow
sources.format: A Star Is Born [2018] Piano/Vocal/Chords Singer Pro
sources.scope: 2018 film-song arrangement performed by Lady Gaga & Bradley Cooper
sources.scopeNote: Musicnotes identifies the 2018 film, lists Lady Gaga & Bradley Cooper as performers, and gives G major as the original published key. This supports the arrangement key, not an exact master transcription.

sources.title: Someone Like You
sources.scopeNote: Musicnotes gives A major as the original published key for its Adele arrangement; the page does not bind the arrangement to a particular album master.

sources.title: Fix You
sources.scopeNote: Musicnotes lists E-flat major as the original published key and associates the arrangement with Coldplay's X&Y. The selected D-sharp pitch class is enharmonically equivalent, but the app claim is recording-scoped while this listing is arrangement-scoped; count this as a scope mismatch, not a same-scope match or recording gold.

sources.title: Chasing Cars
sources.format: Official Faber guitar TAB / voice arrangement
sources.scope: artist arrangement; Faber describes it as recorded by Snow Patrol, Musicnotes associates it with Eyes Open
sources.scopeNote: Faber identifies the transcription as 'as recorded by Snow Patrol'; Musicnotes lists A major as the original published key and associates this product with Eyes Open. The corpus edition is unspecified, so the A/A agreement remains practical chart support rather than a strict recording-specific correctness claim.

sources.title: Nothing Else Matters
sources.format: Official Metallica leadsheet with lyrics, melody, and chords
sources.scopeNote: Musicnotes lists E minor as the original published key and associates the leadsheet with Metallica (1991). The selected application key is unavailable, so this adds a reference but does not count as a key match or correctness result.

sources.title: Piano Man
sources.format: Official Billy Joel Piano/Vocal/Chords Singer Pro arrangement
sources.scope: artist arrangement associated with Piano Man
sources.scopeNote: Musicnotes lists C major as the original published key, identifies voice/piano/accordion scoring, and associates it with the Piano Man catalog. The selected output C agrees at arrangement level; no exact master transcription is claimed.

sources.title: Stairway to Heaven
sources.format: Official Led Zeppelin guitar TAB transcription arrangement
sources.scope: artist arrangement appearing on Led Zeppelin IV
sources.scopeNote: Musicnotes identifies this as an A-minor Guitar TAB transcription arrangement and lists it on Led Zeppelin IV. It corroborates the existing album-performance home-key reference; application output is unavailable, so it adds no output match.

interpretationPolicy.equalKeys: A matching key is practical corroboration for the chart claim, not strict recording-specific gold.
interpretationPolicy.differentKeys: A difference is a review lead, not an automatic error; inspect edition, capo, transposition, and sounding-key scope.
interpretationPolicy.scopeDifference: Do not compare arrangement-key claims to recording-home-key claims as like-scoped values.
interpretationPolicy.copyright: No score images, lyric text, or chord-chart bodies are retained.
